# Dependencies

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### External services

| Service | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Tribunal MNI SOAP webservices (URLs per row in `tribunais`) | Source of processo data, documents, avisos and reference data via `consultarProcesso`, `consultarAvisosPendentes`, `consultarTeorComunicacao`, `entregarManifestacaoProcessual`, `consultarAssuntosJudiciais`, `consultarClassesJudiciais`, `consultarCompetencias`, `consultarJurisdicoes`, `consultarOrgaosJulgadores`, `consultarPrioridadeProcesso` (`app/Services/MNI/`) |
| Comunica PJe API `https://comunicaapi.pje.jus.br/api/v1/comunicacao` | Comunicações lookup (`App\Services\ComunicacaoPJe\ConsultarProcessoService`, TLS verification off); no call site under `app/` |
| AWS S3 (`AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION`, `AWS_BUCKET`, `AWS_URL`, `AWS_ENDPOINT`, `AWS_USE_PATH_STYLE_ENDPOINT`) | Document binaries, HTML sources, export PDFs, presigned links |
| Client callback endpoints (`callback_url`) | Receive monitoramento, export and async-consulta webhooks |
| Sentry | Error tracking + `sentry` log channel (`sentry/sentry-laravel`, `config/sentry.php`) |
| Discord | `discord` log channel (`marvinlabs/laravel-discord-logger`, `config/discord-logger.php`) |
| Coolify | Production deploy triggered by `COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL` + `COOLIFY_API_TOKEN` (`.github/workflows/deploy-production.yaml`) |
| AWS ECR / ECS (`sa-east-1`, cluster `SIM-Cluster`, service `sim-mni`) | Alternate image registry + deploy (`ecr-push.sh`, `ecs-service-deploy.sh`) |
| LLM providers (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `GEMINI_API_KEY`) | Declared for `laravel/ai` in untracked `config/ai.php`; no usage under `app/` |

### Shared infrastructure

| Component | Used for | Wiring |
|---|---|---|
| PostgreSQL 18 (`pgvector/pgvector:pg18`) | All app data; schemas `public`, `cnj`, `pulse` | `docker-compose.yml` service `postgres`; `DB_*` env |
| Redis 7.4.0 | Queue backend for Horizon supervisors | `docker-compose.yml` service `redis`; `REDIS_CLIENT=phpredis`, `REDIS_HOST`, `REDIS_PORT`, `REDIS_PASSWORD` |
| Laravel Horizon | 5 supervisors: `default` (`alta`, `default`), `mni-download`, `exportar`, `monitoramento` (serial), `monitoramento-webhook`; dashboard gated by `viewHorizon` (`HORIZON_ADMIN_EMAILS`, open in `local`) | `config/horizon.php`, `HorizonServiceProvider` |
| Laravel Scheduler | `monitoramentos:despachar` every 30 min, `monitoramentos:limpar-execucoes` 04:30, `mni:consultar-tipos-documentos` 03:00, `cnj:consultar-assuntos` Sundays 05:00, `mni:consultar-orgao` + `cnj:consultar-classes` 04:00 (no matching command signature in `app/Console/Commands/`) | `routes/console.php`; `schedule:work` supervisor program |
| Database cache + sessions | `cache`/`cache_locks`, `sessions` tables | `CACHE_STORE`, `SESSION_DRIVER` fallback `database` |
| `failed_jobs` table | Failed queue jobs (driver `database-uuids`); `app:clean-duplicate-failed-jobs` dedupes by uuid | `config/queue.php` |
| Laravel Pulse | APM dashboard; `pulse:check` program; access via `AuthorizePulse` (any logged-in user, logged) | `config/pulse.php` |
| Log Viewer | Web log viewer; any authenticated user (`LogViewer::auth` in `AppServiceProvider`) | `config/log-viewer.php` |
| Ghostscript `gs` | Normalize merged PDFs to version 1.4 | `exec` in `ExportacaoProcessoService` |
| FrankenPHP / Octane | HTTP server (dev `php-server`, prod `octane:start --server=frankenphp`) | `docker/supervisord/`, `docker/prod/8.4/` |
| Traefik | Local TLS reverse proxy; app trusts all proxies (`trustProxies(at: '*')`) | `traefik/`, `bootstrap/app.php` |
| Docker network `desenvolvimento` | External network joined by compose services | `docker-compose.yml` |

### Package usage status

| Package (composer) | Status under `app/` |
|---|---|
| `barryvdh/laravel-dompdf` | Used: export cover (`ExportacaoProcessoService`), HTML → PDF (`SalvarDocumentoProcessoService::downloadHTML`) |
| `setasign/fpdi` + `tecnickcom/tcpdf` | Used: `setasign\Fpdi\Tcpdf\Fpdi` merges export PDFs |
| `league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3` | Used: `Storage::disk('s3')` |
| `laravel/sanctum` | Used only by `GET /api/user` (`auth:sanctum`) |
| `barryvdh/laravel-snappy`, `h4cc/wkhtmltopdf-amd64`, `h4cc/wkhtmltoimage-amd64` | No reference found; `config/snappy.php` present |
| `webklex/laravel-pdfmerger` | No reference found |
| `laravel/ai` | No reference found; untracked `config/ai.php` + `agent_conversations` migration |
| `LSNepomuceno\LaravelA1PdfSign\ManageCert` | Referenced in `app/Helpers/functions.php` (`validateCertificateDate`, `getHashA1Base64`); package absent from `composer.json`; helpers not called under `app/` |

No first-party/private packages: `composer.json` has no `repositories` entry; `package.json` lists only public npm packages.
